title: Benelli & CFMOTO & KOVE CFMOTO 650MT Adventure (Race Replica)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the CFMOTO Benelli & CFMOTO & KOVE CFMOTO 650MT Adventure (Race Replica) is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 650cc powertrain delivering 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 193 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, backed by a 15.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
